title: Land Of Hope And Dreams
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
Grab your ticket and suitcase thunder's rollin around this track
You don't know where your going but you know you won't be back
Darlin if you're weary lay your head upon my chest
And we'll take what we can carry and we'll leave the rest

[bridge]
Meet me in land of hope and dreams
Now I will provide for you and I will stand by your side
You'll need good companion for this part of the ride
Leave behind your sorrow, we'll let this day be the last

[bridge]
Meet me in land of hope and dreams
This train carries saints and sinners
This train carreis losers and winners
This train carries lost souls
This train carries lost souls
This train dreams will not be thwarted
This train faith will be rewarded
This train hear the steel wheels singing
This train bells of freedom ringing
